messages:
Alexandra "Alex" Park: hey everyone! alex here (she/her)
just started today on BizOps, based in London. i pack a bento like it's a hobby and i'm on a mission to find the office's best hot sauce. hi! :wave: :bento:
Dan: welcome Alex!! :tada: hot sauce detective role accepted. we also do a rotating lunch buddy schedule if you want in.
Priya: hi Alex, welcome! i'm usually in the late-afternoon uk hours. love a bento swap. :grinning_face_with_big_eyes: do you have any dietary restrictions?
Alexandra "Alex" Park: thanks all! no strict restrictions but i'm vegetarian sometimes (flexitarian). happy to label contents.
Yara: welcome! quick Q
has the office fridge ever judged someone's bento? (asking for a friend)
Sam: fridge verdicts: yes. once there was a mystery kimchi jar for 3 weeks. :scream:
Alexandra "Alex" Park: hahaha will brand mine with a sticky note. also curious about joining the lunch buddy rotation
— if it's cool, i'd love to be paired for a week of lunches. short poll: react with :sunrise: if mornings work, :bento: if midday, :crescent_moon: if late afternoons/evenings.
Dan: :bento:
Priya: :bento:
Yara: :crescent_moon:
Sam: :bento:
lunchbot: Lunch Buddy Signup: Alex (week of Apr 12) \u2022 Preferences: midday bento swaps \u2022 Matches suggested: Dan, Priya
Alexandra "Alex" Park: awesome! thanks lunchbot. would anyone be up for a mini "best condiment" showdown at next week's swap? i will bring 3 contenders of hot sauce including my personal favourite.
Dan: absolutely. i'll bring pickles as a wild card. :pickle:
Priya: i'm into this. also, if anyone wants a quick intro to BizOps stuff, happy to do a 15-min sync later this week, Alex?
Alexandra "Alex" Park: yes please that would help a ton. any time after 11:30 BST works for me on Thu or Fri.
Yara: I can make Thu 12:00 BST. keep it short and caffeinated.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Intro: Priya \u2014 BizOps 1:1 with Alex" \u2022 Thu Apr 15 12:00 BST \u2022 15 minutes \u2022 Priya, Alex invited.
Sam: welcome again Alex. looking forward to the condiment showdown. :hot_pepper:
Alexandra "Alex" Park: thanks everyone for the warm welcome! i'll post a quick photo thread of contenders and my bento prep tips in #random later. see you at the swap :)
